session.tip: A specific, dated occurrence of a service that customers can book.

sessionStatus.tip: A session's state: draft, upcoming, in progress, or completed.

capacity.tip: The maximum number of spots available for a session.

buffer.tip: The gap time you reserve before and/or after a session.

booking.tip: A spot taken by a customer for a session, via Marketplace or Direct.

pendingBooking.tip: A Direct booking you need to confirm yourself to lock in the spot.

noShow.tip: A customer who booked but didn't show up, without cancelling.

customer.tip: Anyone who has booked with you at least once.

lifetimeValue.tip: The total a customer has spent with you since their first booking.

instructor.tip: The teacher or coach assigned to a session.

bookingPolicies.tip: Your rules for cancellations, late fees, and booking cutoffs.

freeCancellationWindow.tip: The cutoff before a session below which cancellations aren't fully refunded.

bookingWidget.tip: A booking module you can embed on your own website.

team.tip: Your team's accounts with dashboard access.

analytics.tip: Your stats: bookings, cancellations, channel split.

gate.title: Unlock marketplace bookings
gate.body: Your current plan ({plan}) doesn't include marketplace distribution. Upgrade to Marketplace to start receiving bookings from Moovli app users — you set a list price and a wholesale discount, and receive the net on every marketplace booking.

marketplace.listingHelpLive: Your published sessions appear in the Moovli app discovery feed and studio listings. Bookings are paid via Moovli and you receive payouts on the standard schedule.
marketplace.listingHelpPaused: Your sessions are not visible in the Moovli app. Existing marketplace bookings remain valid and will be honored — only future discoverability is paused.
marketplace.pricingSubtitle: You set your list price — Moovli takes a wholesale discount.
marketplace.exampleNote: Example for a {price} session — your payout scales with each price.

whyDiscount.a: It's what makes the offer attractive to subscribed members. In exchange, you reach new customers with no marketing effort.

existingClients.q: Will my existing clients go through the marketplace?
existingClients.a: No. Your regular clients keep booking through your direct link at your normal price.

removeClass.q: Can I remove a class from the marketplace anytime?
removeClass.a: Yes. You stay in full control.

howItWorks.a: Your discount is the wholesale rate you give Moovli (minimum {floor}%). Moovli lists your session on the marketplace at its own price — set dynamically based on timing and demand — and keeps the difference. Recommended baseline: {baseline}%.

howMuchEarn.a: You always receive your net — your list price minus your discount — no matter what price Moovli sells it at. The discount covers customer acquisition, payment processing, and discovery.
